items.title: Multi-Agent Research System
items.description: A planner/researcher/writer/reviewer LangGraph system with a citation-checked review loop and bounded retries
items.cost_estimate: ~$0.05-0.30 per research question with gpt-4o-mini across 2-6 loop iterations
prerequisites: intermediate-multi-tool-agent
A trusted document corpus or approved web-source list
Clear citation requirements decided before writing the reviewer node
A human review policy for high-impact outputs
items.summary: A planner/researcher/writer/reviewer LangGraph system with a citation-checked review loop and bounded retries

items.title: Self-Correcting RAG
items.description: A RAG pipeline that grades retrieved context, rewrites the query on insufficient evidence, and falls back honestly after bounded retries
items.cost_estimate: ~$0.01-0.08 per question with gpt-4o-mini, scaling with retry count
prerequisites: intermediate-production-rag-api
Golden questions with known evidence, for measuring whether the grader is actually helping
A defined failure policy (what the system says when it truly cannot answer)
A max retry count and latency budget decided in advance
items.summary: A RAG pipeline that grades retrieved context, rewrites the query on insufficient evidence, and falls back honestly after bounded retries

items.title: Document Q&A Pipeline
items.description: Parse, chunk, and index documents into Postgres via pgvector, with provenance metadata and a citation-backed Q&A query
items.cost_estimate: free with local models; requires a running Postgres instance
prerequisites: A running PostgreSQL instance with the pgvector extension available (Docker: postgres:16 plus `CREATE EXTENSION vector`)
Representative documents with real layout complexity (tables, headings) -- clean plain text will hide parsing bugs
A decision on citation granularity (page-level vs. section-level) before writing the chunking code
items.summary: Parse, chunk, and index documents into Postgres via pgvector, with provenance metadata and a citation-backed Q&A query

items.title: Multi-Tool Agent
items.description: A bounded multi-tool agent with validated arguments, Pydantic-typed final answers via Instructor, and Langfuse tracing
items.cost_estimate: ~$0.01-0.05/run with gpt-4o-mini; free with a local model
prerequisites: starter-simple-react-agent
At least two distinct, safe tools
Pydantic model basics
A Langfuse account (self-hosted or cloud free tier) for tracing
items.summary: A bounded multi-tool agent with validated arguments, Pydantic-typed final answers via Instructor, and Langfuse tracing

items.title: Production RAG API
items.description: A FastAPI RAG service backed by Qdrant with request-scoped tracing, source citations, and async ingestion
items.cost_estimate: ~$0.005-0.02/query with gpt-4o-mini; Qdrant Cloud free tier covers small corpora
prerequisites: intermediate-document-qa-pipeline
Docker and Python service experience
A representative document corpus
An authentication/tenant model decided before writing the ingestion worker
items.summary: A FastAPI RAG service backed by Qdrant with request-scoped tracing, source citations, and async ingestion

items.title: Basic RAG Chatbot
items.description: A document-grounded chatbot: LlamaIndex + Chroma + Gradio, source-grounded answers over a local folder of documents
prerequisites: Python 3.11+
A small folder of Markdown/PDF/text documents (2+ files to see retrieval actually discriminate between sources)
Either an OpenAI-compatible API key OR a local Ollama install (see local-llm-chat build example) for the generation step
items.summary: A document-grounded chatbot: LlamaIndex + Chroma + Gradio, source-grounded answers over a local folder of documents

items.title: Local LLM Chat
items.description: Stand up a private local chat stack: Ollama plus Open WebUI via Docker Compose, no cloud API calls
items.cost_estimate: free (all inference runs on your own hardware)
prerequisites: Docker and Docker Compose installed
Enough RAM/VRAM for the model you choose (8GB+ system RAM for a 7-8B quantized model as a rough floor)
No GPU required, but generation will be slow on CPU-only hardware for anything larger than a small quantized model
items.summary: Stand up a private local chat stack: Ollama plus Open WebUI via Docker Compose, no cloud API calls

items.title: Simple ReAct Agent
items.description: A minimal tool-using agent with LangChain's create_agent, a step budget, and traceable tool calls
items.cost_estimate: ~$0.001-0.01 per run with gpt-4o-mini; free with a local Ollama model
prerequisites: Python 3.11+
One safe, read-only tool to start (no write/delete/spend actions)
An OpenAI-compatible API key or local model endpoint
items.summary: A minimal tool-using agent with LangChain's create_agent, a step budget, and traceable tool calls
